escena: SCENE (customer support desk, Santiago, afternoon): a Latin American woman in her thirties in a plain piqué polo sits at her desk RECEIVING — her mouth closed, her eyes looking off-frame at something she is reading, her headset resting on the desk beside her, present and unused. Her hands are still. The key light is a hard, low source from the far left, raking, leaving one side of her face in open shadow with the shadow of her nose legible on her cheek; a second low source behind her cuts a rim along her hair and shoulder, separating her from the wall. All that light and every patch it throws stays BELOW the middle of the frame. A monitor at her side is a glowing cool blue panel carrying a long conversation thread, deliberately out of focus. On the desk behind her, well out of focus, sits a small solid orange desktop sculpture. 135mm lens at f/2, focus on her eyes. Everything except that sculpture is completely unbranded; her polo carries no readable emblem. No readable text anywhere: any lettering is small, angled or out of focus.

lecho.objeto: the boom arm of a second headset crossing the very bottom of the frame, right against the lens

texto.muro: a plain, evenly lit, VERY LIGHT warm-white plaster wall with its texture visible
